paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:2, speaking in Resh Lakish’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim7:2 scalar has untitled חייה בר אדא reporting Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish. Hyman has חייא בר אחא; both the given-name spelling and Ada/Acha patronymic difference remain distinct. Resh Lakish is the inherited rendering of רש״בל, without replacing the source heading or admitting an identity merge. The earlier failed exact needle is historical search provenance, not a new absence result.
